mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine growing up where every day feels like a page from history—where childhood innocence meets the chaos of revolution and war. That's the world we step into together, as we explore Persepolis, Volume 1, written by Marjane Satrapi. Here, Iran of the 1970s and 1980s isn't just a setting—it's a force that shapes every moment, every dream, and every relationship. Through Marjane’s eyes, we witness how political unrest seeps into family life, how it molds identity, and how it turns the ordinary into something extraordinary. What if your memories weren’t just personal, but woven tightly with the fate of a nation? In this story, the boundaries between the intimate and the political simply disappear. Every laugh, every tear, and every act of rebellion becomes a part of something much bigger. As we journey alongside Marjane, we’ll find ourselves questioning faith, justice, and what it really means to belong. There’s humor here, even in the darkest moments, and a deep sense of hope that refuses to fade—proof that resilience can grow even in the most unlikely places. So, as we dive in, let’s open ourselves to the heartbreak, the courage, and the small joys that make up this unforgettable coming-of-age story. Together, we’ll uncover how personal memories become part of a nation’s soul—and why, even when the ground keeps shifting, the search for meaning never stops.
